    Fordham Golf Classic 2026

    Tuesday, October 13, 10 a.m. – 8 p.m.

    Winged Foot Golf Club

    851 Fenimore Rd
    Mamaroneck, NY 10543     + Google Map
    • « Abolish Everything! Live Taping : Young Alumni Outing
    • Tour and Discussion at Central Synagogue NYC (LC) »

    Join us for the 2026 Fordham Golf Classic at Winged Foot.

    Experience a premier day of golf alongside fellow Fordham alumni, parents, supporters and friends at one of the most iconic courses in the country. Winged Foot is set to host the U.S. Open in 2028, offering a unique opportunity to play the course ahead of one of golf’s biggest stages.

    For more information, visit our website.
